# awscc_medialive_input (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::MediaLive::Input Resource Type



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `destinations` (Attributes List) A list of the destinations of the input (PUSH-type). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations))
- `input_devices` (Attributes List) Settings for the input devices. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--input_devices))
- `input_network_location` (String) The location of this input. AWS, for an input existing in the AWS Cloud, On-Prem for
an input in a customer network.
- `input_security_groups` (List of String) A list of security groups referenced by IDs to attach to the input.
- `media_connect_flows` (Attributes List) A list of MediaConnect Flows for this input. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--media_connect_flows))
- `multicast_settings` (Attributes) Multicast Input settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--multicast_settings))
- `name` (String) The user-assigned name (This is a mutable value).
- `role_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the role this input assumes during and after creation.
- `router_settings` (Attributes) Information about the MediaConnect Router association for this input. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--router_settings))
- `sdi_sources` (List of String) SDI Sources for this Input.
- `smpte_2110_receiver_group_settings` (Attributes) Include this parameter if the input is a SMPTE 2110 input, to identify the stream sources for this input. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--smpte_2110_receiver_group_settings))
- `sources` (Attributes List) A list of the sources of the input (PULL-type). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sources))
- `srt_settings` (Attributes) The settings associated with an SRT input. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--srt_settings))
- `tags` (Map of String) A collection of key-value pairs.
- `type` (String) The different types of inputs that AWS Elemental MediaLive supports.
- `vpc` (Attributes) Settings for a private VPC Input.
When this property is specified, the input destination addresses will be created in a VPC rather than with public Internet addresses.
This property requires setting the roleArn property on Input creation.
Not compatible with the inputSecurityGroups property. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpc))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Unique ARN of the input (generated, immutable).
- `attached_channels` (List of String) A list of channel IDs that that input is attached to (currently an input can only be attached to one channel).
- `destination_urls` (List of String) A list of destination URLs of the input (PUSH-type).
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `input_class` (String) STANDARD - MediaLive expects two sources to be connected to this input. If the channel is also STANDARD, both sources will be ingested. If the channel is SINGLE_PIPELINE, only the first source will be ingested; the second source will always be ignored, even if the first source fails.
SINGLE_PIPELINE - You can connect only one source to this input. If the ChannelClass is also SINGLE_PIPELINE, this value is valid. If the ChannelClass is STANDARD, this value is not valid because the channel requires two sources in the input.
- `input_id` (String) The generated ID of the input (unique for user account, immutable).
- `input_partner_ids` (List of String) A list of IDs for all Inputs which are partners of this one.
- `input_source_type` (String) Certain pull input sources can be dynamic, meaning that they can have their URL's dynamically changes
during input switch actions. Presently, this functionality only works with MP4_FILE and TS_FILE inputs.
- `security_groups` (List of String) A list of IDs for all the Input Security Groups attached to the input.
- `source_urls` (List of String) A list of source URLs of the input (PULL-type).
- `state` (String) Placeholder documentation for InputState

Optional:

- `ip` (String) The system-generated static IP address of endpoint.

- `stream_name` (String) The stream name for the input destination.
- `url` (String) This represents the endpoint that the customer stream will be
pushed to.

<a id="nestedatt--smpte_2110_receiver_group_settings--smpte_2110_receiver_groups--sdp_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `smpte_2110_receiver_group_settings.smpte_2110_receiver_groups.sdp_settings`

Optional:

- `ancillary_sdps` (Attributes List) A list of InputSdpLocations. Each item in the list specifies the SDP file and index for one ancillary SMPTE 2110 stream.
Each stream encapsulates one captions stream (out of any number you can include) or the single SCTE 35 stream that you can include. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--smpte_2110_receiver_group_settings--smpte_2110_receiver_groups--sdp_settings--ancillary_sdps))
- `audio_sdps` (Attributes List) A list of InputSdpLocations. Each item in the list specifies the SDP file and index for one audio SMPTE 2110 stream. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--smpte_2110_receiver_group_settings--smpte_2110_receiver_groups--sdp_settings--audio_sdps))
- `video_sdp` (Attributes) The InputSdpLocation that specifies the SDP file and index for the single video SMPTE 2110 stream for this 2110 input. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--smpte_2110_receiver_group_settings--smpte_2110_receiver_groups--sdp_settings--video_sdp))

Optional:

<a id="nestedatt--vpc"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpc`

Optional:

- `security_group_ids` (List of String) A list of up to 5 EC2 VPC security group IDs to attach to the Input VPC network interfaces.
Requires subnetIds. If none are specified then the VPC default security group will be used.
- `subnet_ids` (List of String) A list of 2 VPC subnet IDs from the same VPC.
Subnet IDs must be mapped to two unique availability zones (AZ).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_medialive_input.example
  identity = {
    id = "id"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) The generated ID of the input (unique for user account, immutable)

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_medialive_input.example
  id = "id"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_medialive_input.example "id"
```
